selection: One genuine, unedited Formula1.com race-report photograph per event; all three photographs were visually inspected.
imageSpecificReuseTerms: Unknown. No image-specific reuse licence was displayed in the inspected reports.
photographerCredit: The inspected report image captions do not identify individual photographers. Attribute the source as Formula1.com; do not invent a photographer credit.

assets.imageUrlEvidence: Exact URL of the in-article image associated with the race-winning Mercedes battle caption.
assets.officialCaption: Antonelli passed Russell for the win with just a handful of laps to go
assets.scene: A panning shot of the two Mercedes cars racing closely together at Monza, with Russell's number 63 car sharper in the right foreground and Antonelli following to the left.
assets.keyMomentMatch: Matches the race's decisive Antonelli-versus-Russell fight and the official report's accompanying caption. The photograph shows the chase; it does not by itself establish the exact instant of the completed overtake.
assets.credit: Source: Formula1.com; individual photographer not stated in the inspected caption.
assets.cropAdvice: Cars occupy the lower half; retain the bottom and favour the right side when cropping.

assets.imageUrlEvidence: Exact URL of the in-article restart photograph.
assets.officialCaption: Antonelli made a strong launch at the restart to move into the lead
assets.scene: Antonelli's number 12 Mercedes leads the field toward the camera at Zandvoort, with the other Mercedes and two McLarens visibly following.
assets.keyMomentMatch: Directly matches the official report's key restart moment when Antonelli took the lead from Norris. It is not a photo of Norris's later winning overtake or Verstappen's crash.
assets.credit: Source: Formula1.com. Asset filename identifies Getty Images, but the report does not name the photographer.
assets.cropAdvice: Keep the number 12 Mercedes near the centre; a centred crop retains the lead car and chasing McLarens.

assets.imageUrlEvidence: Exact URL of the in-article photograph of the McLaren team-mate battle.
assets.officialCaption: Piastri led Norris after clearing his team mate on the opening lap of the race
assets.scene: A close front view of Piastri's number 81 McLaren leading Norris's McLaren, with both cars in the frame at the Hungaroring.
assets.keyMomentMatch: Matches the opening phase of the central McLaren team-mate battle described in the race report. It does not show Piastri's later collision, gearbox retirement, or Norris taking the chequered flag.
assets.credit: Source: Formula1.com; individual photographer not stated in the inspected caption.
assets.cropAdvice: A centred or slightly right-weighted crop preserves Piastri's car and the following McLaren.
